details: Deutsche Bank has officially launched its digital asset custody service for institutional and corporate clients in Europe as of November 11, 2026. The service supports major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ether, alongside stablecoins such as USDC, EURC, and EURAU. The bank will manage clients' digital wallets and private keys, though the service is not currently available for retail investors.
title: Deutsche Bank Launches Institutional Crypto Custody

details: Japan's largest brokerage, Nomura Holdings, is reportedly exploring the sale of its crypto unit, Laser Digital. This consideration follows losses incurred by the Zurich-based subsidiary last year, which negatively impacted Nomura's European operations. Marex Group is among the potential buyers being evaluated, though no final decision has been made.
title: Nomura Considers Selling Crypto Unit Laser Digital After Losses

details: Suiet, a browser extension wallet designed for the Sui blockchain, is preparing to shut down, with its API services scheduled to end after November 14, 2026. This development occurs amid a significant cooling in the Sui ecosystem's decentralized finance (DeFi) activity, marked by a more than 22% drop in its total value locked (TVL) over the past month. This makes Suiet the latest in a series of service providers withdrawing from the Sui ecosystem.
title: Suiet Wallet to Cease Operations as Sui DeFi Activity Declines

details: Bitcoin is currently holding steady around $73,600, contributing to a global crypto market capitalization of $2.55 trillion, which saw a modest 0.4% increase. Despite this stability, the Fear and Greed Index has dipped to 28, signaling a "Fear" sentiment among investors. This cautious mood is influenced by ongoing concerns regarding hacks and potential index removals affecting certain crypto-related firms.
title: Bitcoin Stabilizes Near $74K Amid Investor Caution

details: Cryptocurrency analyst CrediBULL Crypto has predicted an impending short squeeze for Bitcoin, suggesting a rapid price surge from $72,000 to $90,000 within a few days. This forecast comes as Bitcoin maintains support at its 200-day moving average, positioned near $73,200.
title: Analyst Foresees Bitcoin Short Squeeze to $90,000

details: Mark Moss, co-founder of the Bitcoin Opportunity Fund, has expressed a highly optimistic view on Bitcoin's current market position. He asserts that the increasing accessibility of Bitcoin through traditional financial avenues like banks and ETFs makes this period the "best buying opportunity ever," anticipating that Bitcoin will achieve a new record high in 2027.
title: Mark Moss: Bitcoin Presents 'Best Buying Opportunity Ever'

details: Blockchain analytics firm Arkham reported that the Bitget hacker has moved $78.61 million in Bitcoin from labeled wallets over the past six days, between November 6 and November 11. A significant portion, $63.43 million (80.5%), was channeled through CoinJoin transactions, which aim to obscure the origin and destination of funds. The hacker's wallets still retain $71.44 million in Bitcoin, as Bitget continues its recovery efforts following the breach.
title: Bitget Hacker Moves $78.61M in Bitcoin in Six Days
